provenance.network: in-memory external Git/Release transport; no production data

configuration:
schemaVersion: 3
candidateRetentionDays: 30
sources:
  dlc:
    repository: v2fly/domain-list-community
    version: latest-release
    input:
      format: plain-yaml
      asset: dlc.dat_plain.yml
      checksum: dlc.dat_plain.yml.sha256sum
target:
  repository: wangyingang/sing-box-rule-artifacts
  branch: main
ruleSets:
  - id: openai
    source: dlc
    list: openai
    stablePath: stable/openai
    usages:
      route:
        artifact: domains
      dns-query:
        artifact: domains
      dns-response:
        unavailable: empty
  - id: anthropic
    source: dlc
    list: anthropic
    stablePath: stable/anthropic
    usages:
      route:
        artifact: domains
      dns-query:
        artifact: domains
      dns-response:
        unavailable: empty
  - id: google-deepmind
    source: dlc
    list: google-deepmind
    stablePath: stable/google-deepmind
    usages:
      route:
        artifact: domains
      dns-query:
        artifact: domains
      dns-response:
        unavailable: empty
